# Sensitivity and sink-demand comparisons

<p>Sensitivity coverage is limited to explicit declarations. Undeclared content is not proven non-sensitive. Comparisons apply to the recorded processing and task-demand rules, not to all possible implementations. Completed input assessments identify removable ranges under the reviewed input contracts. A possible dependency is not evidence that sensitive plaintext is present.</p>

<details id="excerpt-6b86b273ff34fce19d6b"><summary>skill/SKILL.md lines 13–19</summary><pre>&quot;2.  **API Key:** Generate an API Key.\n3.  **Search Engine ID (CX):** Create a Programmable Search Engine at [cse.google.com](https://cse.google.com/cse/all), and get your CX ID.\n4.  **Environment:** Store your credentials in a `.env` file in your workspace:\n    ```\n    GOOGLE_API_KEY=your_key_here\n    GOOGLE_CSE_ID=your_cx_id_here\n    ```\n&quot;</pre></details>
